jobs.name: scientist
jobs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create a corrected standalone SCIENTIST HAIR WIG from the silver white scientist hair in the lower left of image 1; image 2 is ONLY the game character proportions reference. Dense, short, wild swept-back silver-white spiky hair in this richly shaded hand-painted cartoon game style with clean dark outline. A compact complete crown of hair meant for the green chibi zombie facing RIGHT in three-quarter side view. Critical: the cap/crown is SOLID and DENSE across its entire top and side, with a short continuous wavy forehead fringe along the lower right edge; NO hollow square, face-sized hole, empty middle, huge U-shaped wig, big sideburn curtains, beard, or long locks beside the mouth. Hair ends near the tops of the ears. The upper spikes sweep to the LEFT/back of head. Only the standalone hair accessory, no character, face, skin, eyes, ears, body, text or shadow, genuine transparent background, centered and completely within frame with margin.
